Security Module

Unified Visitor Management & Guard App

A secure, professional, and end-to-end check-in system that coordinates guest registration, real-time security gate approval, and downloadable digital passes.

01

Visitor Portal

Guests fill out basic details, take a selfie check-in photo, select their host, and specify the reason for visit.

  • Selfie Verification
  • Govt ID Upload
  • Custom Branding
02

Visitor ID Card (IC)

An instant, downloadable pass is generated containing a secure, short-lived verification token within a custom styled QR code.

  • Branded Passes
  • Download as PNG
  • High-Sec QR Token
03

Guard Verification

Guards scan the QR code via their mobile Guard App to verify details, authorize entry, log checkout, and notify hosts.

  • Gate & Door Sync
  • Host Arrival Alerts
  • Real-time Checkout

Verified Onboarding

Support for custom verification workflows: collect selfies, capture identity proof documents, and cross-reference details before entry approval.

Assigned Gate Management

Tie guards to specific physical entrances (doors/turnstiles). Keep entries segregated and track exactly which visitor crossed which gate.

Automated Host Alerts

Guards instantly trigger secure notifications to the hosts (via system notification, SMS, or email) the moment the visitor's pass is verified.

Digital Audit Trails

Complete compliance tracking. Maintain logs of check-in, check-out, host confirmation, and average stay duration for site audit compliance.
